an3.125:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Gotamake cetiye.
an3.125:2.1: Abhiññāyāhaṃ bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi na anabhiññāya,
an3.125:2.2: sanidānāhaṃ bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi no anidānaṃ,
an3.125:2.3: sappāṭihāriyāhaṃ bhikkhave dhammaṃ desemi no appāṭihāriyaṃ.
an3.125:2.4: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave abhiññāya dhammaṃ desayato no anabhiññāya, sanidānaṃ dhammaṃ desayato no anidānaṃ sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desayato no appāṭihāriyaṃ, karaṇīyo ovādo karaṇiyā anusāsanī.
an3.125:2.5: Alañ ca pana vo bhikkhave tuṭṭhiyā alam attamanatāya alaṃ somanassāya --
an3.125:2.6: sammāsambuddho Bhagavā svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo supaṭipanno saṅgho ti.
an3.125:3.2: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti.
an3.125:3.3: Imasmiñ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne sahassīlokadhātu akampitthā ti. 124. 1.
